title: Choosing the new for a living joy

captions.energy: Opening to experience without fixed roles
captions.emotions: Open joy in a useful result

meaning: An open introduction to something new can inspire you when choosing together brings pleasure in a living benefit for other people.
text: A new shared purpose can begin with a free decision to try. The Fool in the energy of Sahasrara supports openness to experience without knowing your role beforehand. The Lovers in the physical position describe shared actions: discussing close values, voluntarily choosing participation and confirming agreement through a decision. The Sun in emotions brings open pleasure when usefulness becomes visible. It feels rewarding that your choice already supports an opportunity available to others. Something unfamiliar need not immediately become a large final endeavour to offer a real meeting, fresh interest or a first personal experience.

For example, you choose together to help a first open music evening. You both want to try participation in which people can sing without prior confidence or an established permanent role. **A freely shared choice gives new meaning a visible, living benefit.** Unfamiliar voices find a simple tune, bringing clear pleasure: your decision helps people meet. Shared interest gains life beyond private conversation, with continuation through new songs, participants’ questions and their own manageable wish to return after the first gathering.

The difficulty may arise if agreement predetermines what each participant’s result should become. You both welcome the new but choose one correct continuation for others. An open motive and bright pleasure remain supportive. Action benefits from leaving people their own beginning, accepting a shared contribution without making it an obligation to decide someone else’s entire later story.
